fix_steps: Verify that your identity provider is not modifying the SAML assertion after signing it.
Ensure that any intermediate proxies or load balancers are not altering the XML structure of the SAML response.
Re-export the SAML metadata from your identity provider and update the configuration in our system to ensure the signing keys and algorithms match.
parsed.summary: Your SSO login is failing because the SAML response signature is invalid. The digest mismatch indicates that the data in the assertion has been altered or corrupted after it was signed by your identity provider.
